description: Add (or remove, if remove=true) a wall segment starting at (x,y) running in octant `direction` for `length` tiles on `level`. Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side gate via VMTSOLotState.OwnerID; server-side also refuses if < BuildBuyRoommate via Validator.CanBuildTool). Effect: wall appears (or disappears) — observable via query-architecture at the affected tiles; perception does not expose walls. Cost: wall materials are debited from lot funds by the server during Architecture.RunCommands (indirect — not a direct GlobalLink transaction). Denial is a silent drop with no error PDU back (OQ-8). Wire: VMNetArchitectureCmd { Commands: [{ Type: WALL_LINE | WALL_DELETE, level, x, y, x2=length, y2=direction, pattern, style }] } on the lot Aries socket.
